import os

expected_installer = os.environ['FIXTURE_EXPECTED_INSTALLER']
args = sys.argv[1:]
if args[:1] != [expected_installer]:
    raise SystemExit('unexpected installer path')
stage = pathlib.Path(args[args.index('--built-runtime') + 1])
built = pathlib.Path(os.environ['FIXTURE_BUILT_RUNTIME'])
log.write_text(log.read_text(encoding='utf-8') + f'python:{stage}\n', encoding='utf-8')
if stage.read_bytes() != built.read_bytes():
    raise SystemExit('staged runtime bytes mismatch')
if mode == 'installer_failure':

('#!/usr/bin/env bash

    printf 'copy:%s\n' "$4" >> "$FIXTURE_STAGE_LOG"
    return 71

}

}
